screens.note: The Panel settings menu is shown only for GET, GT and GT+. On G16/G16T/E16/E16T the panel fields are under System options.

liveOnly.what: 'Reading… n%' status and progress bar while a configuration is read
liveOnly.why: driven by the realtime configuration-event channel during a live read

liveOnly.what: 'Preparing…' / 'Writing… n%' status and progress bar, and the write result
liveOnly.why: driven by the realtime channel during a live write; writes are never sent
